summary: The reader has finished an undergraduate computer science degree: asymptotic analysis, basic algorithms, discrete mathematics (modular arithmetic, primes, counting, induction), linear algebra over the reals and complex numbers including matrices, rank, invertibility, subspaces and inner products, and elementary Turing machines. They have seen the idea of the FFT and polynomial multiplication, but not Schönhage–Strassen-style multiplication, Nussbaumer transforms, Harvey–van der Hoeven techniques, or specialist tensor and finite-field matrix factorization material.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and congruences
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers taken modulo m, with a ≡ b (mod m) meaning m divides a-b.

known.name: Prime numbers and coprimality
known.gloss: Primes are integers greater than 1 with no proper divisors, and integers are coprime when their greatest common divisor is 1.

known.name: Floor and ceiling functions
known.gloss: The largest integer at most x, the smallest integer at least x, and rounding of reals to integers.

known.name: Binary representation of integers
known.gloss: Writing nonnegative integers in base 2 as bit strings, and signed integers in two's complement.

known.name: Hamming weight
known.gloss: The number of 1 bits in a binary string.

known.name: Logarithms and exponentials
known.gloss: Standard logarithm and exponential identities, with lg meaning log base 2.

known.name: Matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Matrices as linear maps on vector spaces, with products, inverses, and standard basis vectors.

known.name: Rank, subspaces and orthogonal complements
known.gloss: Dimension of a subspace or of the image of a linear map, and the subspace of vectors orthogonal to a given one.

known.name: Linear algebra over the field F_2
known.gloss: Vectors and matrices with bit entries where addition is XOR, including the general linear group of invertible binary matrices.

known.name: Gaussian elimination
known.gloss: Reducing a matrix to triangular or identity form by elementary row operations, expressing invertible matrices as products of elementary ones.

known.name: Triangular and permutation matrices
known.gloss: Matrices that are zero on one side of the diagonal, and matrices that reorder coordinates.

known.name: Tensor (Kronecker) product of vectors and matrices
known.gloss: The product acting on multi-indexed arrays by applying maps independently along each index.

known.name: Gaussian integers
known.gloss: Complex numbers whose real and imaginary parts are integers.

known.name: Dyadic rationals
known.gloss: Rationals of the form a/2^k, representable with finitely many binary digits.

known.name: Complex modulus and norms
known.gloss: The size |a+bi| of a complex number and vector norms with the triangle inequality.

known.name: Euler's formula and complex exponentials
known.gloss: e^{iθ}=cosθ+i sinθ, so e^{2πi/n} is a primitive nth root of unity.

known.name: Abstract algebra basics: rings and fields
known.gloss: Sets with addition and multiplication satisfying the usual axioms, and polynomial quotient rings as examples.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform divide-and-conquer idea
known.gloss: Computing a length-2^k DFT in O(n log n) by recursively splitting into halves combined with two-point butterflies.

known.name: Binomial coefficients and counting
known.gloss: Counting subsets and arrangements, including three-element subsets of a set.

known.name: Recurrences and recursion analysis
known.gloss: Bounding the cost of recursive algorithms by solving recurrences and by induction.

known.name: Little-o, Theta and Omega asymptotics
known.gloss: Standard asymptotic comparison notations and arithmetic with polylog factors.

known.name: Sorting and permutation routing on tapes
known.gloss: Sorting n items in O(n log n) comparisons or steps, and applying a given permutation to an array.

known.name: Schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication
known.gloss: The quadratic digit-by-digit multiplication algorithm and Karatsuba's divide-and-conquer improvement.

known.name: Finite-state machine and constant-size alphabet
known.gloss: A Turing machine's constant-size control and alphabet, so each step does bounded local work.
